decision: Holdout: every day from 2025-10-13 on is reserved; tester jobs end by 2025-09-30 and agents never run holdout_check.py.
why: Keep one clean out-of-sample stretch that no agent has tuned on.

decision: The Strategy Tester runs in its own MT5 install; terminal 16 keeps the demo EA untouched.
why: A tester job must never stop or change the demo.

decision: Model router: orchestrator on Opus, tester on Haiku, the other roles on their agent definitions.
why: Spend the strong model where judgement is needed and keep mechanical jobs cheap.

decision: Both EAs share one leg library in mql5/Include/Aurum.
why: A leg fixed once is fixed in both EAs.

decision: j3 judged: the AurumFunded legs pass step 16 (tester keeps 67-74% of the model's log growth).
j5 thrown out and rerun as j6 with every input written.
why: The preset omitted inputs, so the tester reused the previous run's values and off/on came out identical.

decision: j6 judged: the AurumHydra legs pass step 16 at size 1 (83-87% of the model).
Approval a3: legs switched on in the FTMO demo preset.
j8: the 5x goal mode reached 5x in 1 of 21 months; not released and not tuned on those months.
why: Far below the model's 40-47%; tuning on the tester window would overfit.
Raising it made the months worse; the cap works as a volatility filter.
No variant reaches net Sharpe 0.5 in both halves; round levels do no better than arbitrary ones.

decision: The correlation gate fails a candidate only on positive correlation with existing legs.
why: A negatively correlated leg diversifies and should not be rejected.
They failed because the tester install had no login; the owner has logged in since.

decision: j13/j14 end 2025-09-30; j12 kept as the yardstick.
Shared memory started: mission.md (owner-only), decisions.jsonl (append-only), lessons.md (orchestrator-curated, reviewer-checked), tools/memory.py.
why: Agents are stateless runs; they need one place for what was decided and learned.
